AUCTUM GMBH · GERMANY

Tile & floor profiles – Schlüter-Systems, Profilpas and more

Complete warehouse and showroom stock of a tile-accessories distributor: tile edge trims, transition, ramp and stair profiles, movement joints, balcony and terrace systems, skirting, waterproofing and wall protection. About half of the lines are Schlüter-Systems; also Profilpas, Arfen, Havos, Bohemia Profil, Profilitec, Sika/Schönox. New goods, original packaging.
